title: ApexGO optimizes antimicrobial peptide activity
summary: ApexGO uses Bayesian optimization with a peptide variational autoencoder and an activity-prediction oracle to optimize derivatives of ten peptide templates. The primary article reports 100 synthesized sequences tested in vitro and activity improvements; selected candidates showed activity in mouse A. baumannii infection models. These results are preclinical and do not establish human efficacy.
ai_technology: ApexGO; peptide variational autoencoder; Bayesian optimization; APEX predictor

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broad deployment are not established by this review.
evidence.ai_role: A predictor scores generated peptide derivatives and Bayesian optimization uses feedback to propose variants; researchers synthesize and test them in vitro and in mouse models.
